one_liner: FanBasis (now Commas) has a REST public API with x-api-key keys from the merchant dashboard, plus sandbox and webhooks; only a third-party Zapier MCP was found.
auth_notes: Public API uses x-api-key header. A third-party integration doc states no OAuth is used.
access_notes: Credentials come from the merchant dashboard API section, and the platform is free to start (revenue-share). Sandbox environment exists. Whether API access is gated by account approval is not verified.
blocker_notes: Docs are at apidocs.fan; the evidence comes largely from third-party mirrors. Vendor MCP not checked in vendor docs, but only a Zapier MCP was found.

evidence.quote: No OAuth, no client ID/secret pairs — Fanbasis uses a single API key with separate test/live environments.
Log in to your Fanbasis merchant dashboard
It's free to start selling, as FanBasis operates on a revenue-share model
The sandbox environment allows you to test payments without real money:
Full Fanbasis API integration: checkout sessions, customers, subscribers, discount codes, products, transactions, refunds, and webhook management.
Zapier FanBasis MCP lets you connect FanBasis's actions with any AI tool that supports MCP
